'''Mee rebus''' ({{IPAc-en|ipa|ˌ|m|iː|_|r|ə|ˈ|b|oʊ|s|,_|-|ʊ|s}} {{respell|mee|_|rə|BOHSS}} or {{respell|rə|BUUSS}}, {{IPA|ms|mi rəbos|lan}}, also known as '''mie rebus'''/'''mi rebus''' and '''mie kuah''' (the latter literally means "[[noodle]] [[Broth|soup]]" in [[Indonesian language|Indonesian]])<ref name="Nicole">{{cite web | title = A Guide on What To Eat in Indonesia Part II | author = Nicole | date = 4 November 2015 | work = That Food Cray | url = http://www.thatfoodcray.com/a-guide-on-what-to-eat-in-indonesia-part-ii-savoury-foods/}}</ref> is a [[Maritime Southeast Asia]]n [[noodle soup]] dish. Literally translated as "boiled noodles", it is popular in Maritime Southeast Asian countries such as [[Indonesia]], [[Malaysia]], and [[Singapore]].
